summary: A short message that assistive technology announces as soon as it appears.

variant.description: What kind of message it is, which sets its colours.

root.note: A row of an optional icon and the message. One line of it is a control tall. A variant tints the face, the ink and the line.

icon.note: An optional leading icon the author marks with data-part="icon", at the icon offset from the start and centred on the message's first line.

guidance.text: An author who wants the message announced politely writes role="status"; the alert keeps a role the author wrote.
